algorithm.convergence_criteria: No iterative convergence criterion is relevant or supplied; numerical score stability and decision stability are also not reported.
software: The paper mentions Matlab but supplies no versioned code, data file, environment, seed, or machine-readable output.

assumptions: Use truthfulness, topic, partner, direction, identity, AHP, threshold, semantic, and leader premises only as explicit assumptions.
Keep cleanup decisions, labels, scenario cohort, score semantics, threshold, corroboration, and action authority separate from evaluation.
models.computational_cost: No complete runtime, memory, annotation, privacy, false-positive, false-negative, or deployment cost is reported.

details: Membership screening, Fisher comparison, semantic refinement, and leader analysis are distinct stages.
The source models are non-dynamic scoring procedures; no equilibrium analysis applies or is supplied.
The source supplies message traffic, partial labels, topic descriptions, and figures but no frozen machine-readable data or code.
Data, identity, label, graph, parameter, threshold, semantic, baseline, and leader uncertainty are not propagated.

constraints: Preserve person, message, topic, edge, metric, score, rank, class, leader hypothesis, and action identity at each handoff.
Do not promote contact, activity, manager status, topic use, graph position, ECNAM rank, or leader score to guilt or causality.

equation_status.reason: All numbered source equations assigned to this unit are retained in source order and visually checked.

models.family: network metrics, topic indexes, and a summed leader score on the inferred subnetwork

governing_equations.label: Eq.21 / leader detection score
governing_equations.purpose: rank leader candidates within the inferred subnetwork
governing_equations.source_note: Displayed source structure visually reconciled against bounded q176 formula proxies; printed notation and arithmetic defects remain warnings rather than silent repairs.

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: Formula structures and displayed results are inspectable, but data cleaning, graph construction, labels, weights, thresholds, cohorts, and independent truth are incomplete.

limitations: The inferred cohort is inconsistent, metrics are unnormalized, leader truth is unavailable, and actions lack authority and error-cost controls.
missing_details: Executable code, frozen message graph, identity log, label provenance, parameter derivation, calibration, threshold protocol, independent test labels, privacy review, and decision authority are absent.
objectives: translate inferred membership into structural hypotheses and investigation priorities

parameter_estimation.method: Direct graph calculations, judgmental coding, AHP preferences, Fisher sample statistics, and equal semantic coefficients.

strengths: The source makes node/link decomposition, factor meanings, worked verification, baseline comparison, scenario reruns, semantic repair, and downstream actions visible.
